title: Post-mortem reveals students died from suffocation, not burns in Alijanj fire
summary: A post-mortem report on the Alijanj tragedy indicates that fifteen students died due to asphyxiation rather than burn injuries. Fire brigade officials have stated they made surprising revelations regarding how these children were trapped.
summary_points: Fifteen students in the Alijanj fire incident are reported dead.

summary_points_hi: अलीगंज अग्निप्रहारे में पंद्रह छात्रों को मृत घोषित किया गया है।
